answer: Seeded Role Lottery draws each agent's duties from a beacon the attacker cannot precompute, and admission requires holding a slot long enough to hear the whisper of the next round's seed. Every identity must solve one beacon-derived challenge before its first action, so mass registration collapses into serial waiting a wharf of patience cannot shortcut. The cost is one full seed cycle per identity plus a unique challenge solution, and a karst of pre-built accounts gains nothing until each pays that delay.
